top_story.headline: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar discloses about 50 stock trades, mostly September 24 partial sales
top_story.dek: The Florida Republican's October 7 report covers sales of Boeing, Microsoft, Meta, UnitedHealth and SpaceX stock, among others.
paragraphs: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar's periodic transaction report lists dozens of stock trades. Most are partial sales dated September 24 in a UBS IRA account, each in the $1,001–$15,000 range; the largest is a full sale of Cisco Systems, Inc. stock in her brokerage account for $15,001–$50,000.

The report also lists purchases of Meta Platforms, Inc. (September 22), Chevron Corporation (September 2), Corning Incorporated and Snowflake Inc., plus a partial sale of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. stock. It shows an October 1 notification date and an October 7 signature.

sections.headline: No new OGE ethics filings flagged this week
paragraphs: The U.S. Office of Government Ethics reported 28 filings in the monitoring window (October 6 through today), but none triggered the mechanical filters for certificates of divestiture, terminations, or conflicts requiring immediate attention.

sections.headline: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar reports roughly 50 stock trades, mostly partial sales on September 24
paragraphs: Two House periodic transaction reports, one Senate periodic transaction report and six candidate reports are new since the last edition. All three trade reports were read in full, so the cap of 30 was not reached. Most of Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar's sales were on a single day, September 24, in an IRA account; the report was signed October 7.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

sections.headline: Rep. Virginia Foxx filed 8 trade reports last year, none in 91 days
paragraphs: 1 House member(s) with a history of frequent stock trading have stopped filing trade reports.

items: Rep. Virginia Foxx (R-NC-5) filed 8 periodic transaction reports in the 12 months from 7/11/2025 to 7/11/2026, and none in the 91 days since the last, on 7/10/2026

blocks.text: House members who filed 6 or more periodic transaction reports (STOCK Act trade disclosures) in the year before the last 90 days and none since, per the House Clerk's disclosure index. Silence doesn't say why: the member may have sold off holdings, moved assets into a blind trust or index fund, been covered by a new law, or just not traded -- and trades are reportable up to 45 days late, so the latest ones may not be filed yet. House members only; the Senate's e-filing search isn't covered.
